title: Piracy Defense
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Non-lethal autonomous defenses. In the Autonomous Cargo Ships system this piece plays the security role: it deters pirates Maturity: design.
how_it_works: Assemble the Piracy Defense from its qualified components.
Wire its interfaces (power, data, control, mechanical) to the system bus.
Run subsystem-level functional and stress tests.
Integrate with the full system and re-run the acceptance suite.
safety: System-level hazard analysis before power-on
Interlocks verified end to end
Two-person rule for high-energy steps
Incident log reviewed after every test
troubleshooting: Integration failure: test each interface alone, then pairs
Noise or crosstalk: check grounding and shielding
Timing faults: verify clocks and synchronization margins
Regression after change: diff the configuration against the last good build
citations: Documented public research on Autonomous Cargo Ships: peer-reviewed literature, technical standards, industry announcements, and open technical documentation.
